scientific_integrity: Proof relies on direct exact moment identities, monotone curvature, dominated Riemann sums, and an independently derived Fourier-Plancherel integral; finite diagnostics alone are not used to assert the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive monomial degree on unweighted analytic Bergman annuli; no classification for arbitrary symbols, weights, or changing degrees. Positive-level spectral convergence only; an independent mathematical audit has not been conducted.
title: A thin-annulus spectral law for analytic Bergman multiplication commutators
